limitations: Two solo observations and one paired batch per original; historical same-host baseline, not randomized interleaved trials.
Fresh old-binary ECMA control confirms that workload baseline only.
Peak RSS is not cumulative allocation or post-GC live heap; fixed soft target affects growth.
CPU/heap campaigns are separate diagnostic observations, not replacement capacity figures.
No HTTP RPS, higher concurrency, huge PPTX, arbitrary output generation, universal visual parity or long-lived process leak qualification.
Some peaks increase; explicit work-policy default rejections remain unchanged.
Individual change speedups are not causally isolated; combined final implementation is compared to baseline.
